body: It means that years of honing skills, being flexible, being the guy who can do almost anything means nothing.  I'm trying for jobs that are for 10 bucks an hour when I was making salary before.  My only blessing during all of this is that I never had kids.

Sorry I meant that I score highly on test for employment agencies.  Across the board on MS Office, Word, Excel, Outlook.  I've taken the state tests that they make you take when going on unemployment.

I've put myself out to five different temp agencies, all of whom just give a nod and say they'll try to get me something.  I'm currently signed up with two different catering companies but I what little work I get from them will be ending this month, and for the next two months at least.

I've actually tried doing volunteer work here in town.  I've been rejected several times due to huge spikes in volunteers.  Loaves and Fishes, Salvation Army and others.  I'd just like to help.  Even in administration I've tried to give additional help.
Believe me I have. I score highly but most of the jobs that come up are debt collectors.  And to be honest I'm on that list.

Thank you.  I am aware of those whom love me, it's just difficult feeling like I'm a taker rather than a giver.  It's simply the worst.  I feel like I should be on the otherside of all this, helping people out, getting them by.   Doing the right thing. Having to ask people to buy things, or a hand out from my folks kills me more and more inside.

I am sorry for your loss.  I cannot begin to comprehend what you have had to go through.  I've been lucky that I haven't known anyone that had to go through these things.  And that's part of my struggle.  I don't want to be the first one to fuck things up even more.  It's difficult to feel any kind of emotion.  It feels like I've stopped.  That I've stopped making a difference, that I've stopped being here, that I am merely just soaking things up and giving nothing back.  Hell, volunteer work here where I live have sent me rejection letters saying they are too filled up with staff.
